adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies legacy `embeddable_hosts` by doing raw SQL string interpolation: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` (bypassing ActiveRecord callbacks). That means values like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` are stored verbatim, without the normalization performed in `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation` (which strips protocol and paths). Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the request URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against the bare `uri.host`, so those migrated rows would not match and would stop authorizing embeds. Additionally, interpolating `h` directly into SQL will break on quotes and is potentially unsafe. This is a correctness and safety defect introduced by the diff.
